h.contrast: Not Russian г: a voiced fricative, not a plosive. Russian has a similar [ɣ] only marginally, in words such as ага and бухгалтер.

g.contrast: Like Russian г: a plosive. Few words have this letter.

e.contrast: Like Russian э, not е: the consonant before it stays hard.

ye.contrast: Like Russian е in ель. After a consonant it softens it.

y.contrast: Written like Russian и, but a different sound, close to ы. The consonant before it stays hard.

i.contrast: This is the sound of Russian и.

yi.contrast: Russian has no such letter. Always two sounds.

ts.contrast: Unlike Russian ц, it can also be soft: кінець, ця.

ch.contrast: Unlike Russian ч, it is hard, except before і, я, ю.

shch.contrast: Two hard sounds, [ш] + [ч], not the long soft Russian щ.
